STUDY 075
Pink Crop Top & Quilted Skirt
Rights check / Repeats Study 48.
Source: 24317.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, dark brown hair
arms herself with a cross-armed pose in a gravel lot.
She wears a hot pink one-shoulder crop top and a hot
pink satin mini skirt with a quilted cream panel. Her
expression is calm and friendly. Bright, sunny daylight
with blue sky and a low building behind her. Palette of
hot pink, cream, and sky blue. Bold and sporty, in the
style of a summer street-style photo.
Bold, sporty, sunny
WORKING NOTES
- This is a near-duplicate of the pink set in section 48;
keep only one if you don't need both.
- Add 'shallow depth of field' to separate her from the lot.
